本版采用每日训练的案例写法：先分析事件，再展开参考答案。保留1,000个练习、25个主题和原有操作。它们来自100个基础情境的十种决策练习，并非1,000个独立编写的事件。

This edition uses the daily-training case style: analyze the incident before opening the answer. It retains 1,000 exercises, 25 topics and the original controls. These are ten guided decisions for each of 100 underlying situations, not 1,000 independently authored incidents.

本次是写法与编排改写，现行法规核验未完成。参考答案的“必须事项”列出初稿中的安全处理底线，不代表完整、已核实的法定义务。场景人数、时间及金额是练习事实，不是法律门槛。模板中的旧核验日期没有作为本版核验结果沿用。

This is a writing and presentation revision; current rule verification is incomplete. “Required actions” sets out draft safety safeguards, not a complete verified statement of legal duties. Scenario counts, times and amounts are exercise facts, not legal thresholds. The template’s earlier checked dates have not been reused as verification for this edition.

Learn first, then practice

Read the bilingual incident and questions, write or discuss your action plan, then reveal the reference answer. Use fictional facts; do not enter child or family records.

1. Supervision & transitions 监管与活动转换

CA-0001 · CORE-0001 · FAM-001 · center · DRAFT

门口交接 — 即时处理
Doorway handoff — Immediate response

Mia已把Leo标为接收，Jordan却没有回应交接。

Mia marks Leo received, but Jordan has not answered the handoff.

作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“门口交接”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。附近有成人，不代表对方知道自己已经接手照看。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Doorway handoff”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证监管、活动转换与出勤程序。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify supervision, transitions, and attendance procedures for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

CA-0002 · CORE-0002 · FAM-001 · home · DRAFT

门口交接 — 独自工作
Doorway handoff — Working alone

Mia要用相邻房间，现场可帮忙的住户却未确认照护资格。

Mia needs the adjoining room; the only available household adult has no confirmed care role.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？

As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

继续负责这个孩子和全组。没有已核实合格人员明确接手，就不让孩子独自进入另一房间。使用可安全照看的获准区域，不能继续安全照护时启用允许的应变安排。

Keep responsibility for the child and group. Do not send the child through the doorway without a verified eligible person clearly accepting care. Use the safe approved area and the permitted contingency plan if safe care cannot continue.

实务处理 / Practical approach

你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。

Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.

保留“门口交接”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。附近有成人，不代表对方知道自己已经接手照看。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

门口交接 — 要求破例
Doorway handoff — Pressure for an exception

家长请Mia把Leo留在Jordan门口，不必等接手回应。

A parent asks Mia to leave Leo at Jordan's doorway without acknowledgment.

作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？你会怎样解释，并提供什么替代安排，而不承诺未经核实的例外？

As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What would you explain, and what alternative could you offer without promising an unverified exception?

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

平静说明这次具体顾虑，提供本事件可行的安全安排。不便或同意，都不能证明法律上确有例外。

Explain the specific concern calmly and offer the safe option identified for this event. Do not turn inconvenience or consent into proof that a legal exception exists.

CA-0004 · CORE-0004 · FAM-001 · home · DRAFT

门口交接 — 代班交接
Doorway handoff — Substitute handoff

Mia将把Leo交给Jordan，稍后代班却还不知道这个安排。

Mia will hand Leo to Jordan; the later substitute has not been told that arrangement.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？交接前，代班人员必须能说清什么、找到什么？

As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? Before responsibility changes, what must the substitute be able to explain and find?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

交代本事件、现有防护、必要的儿童个人说明和未决事项。请代班人员说出下一步并找到相关记录，再明确交接；实际岗位资格另行核实。

Brief the substitute on this event, the current safeguard, necessary child-specific instructions and any unresolved decision. Have them explain the next action and locate the relevant record before a clear handoff. Verify their actual role separately.

CA-0005 · CORE-0005 · FAM-001 · center · DRAFT

门口交接 — 说法与记录不符
Doorway handoff — Conflicting accounts

Mia的交接便条写已接收，Jordan的教室名单却没有Leo。

Mia's handoff note says accepted; Jordan's room list does not include Leo.

作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？你会保留、核实和更正什么？哪些紧急行动不能等到大家说法一致？

As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What would you preserve, verify and correct, and which urgent actions must not wait for agreement?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

保留原始说法，区分亲见、转述和未知。根据实际依据，留下有日期、可追溯的补充或更正。不能为了统一故事拖延紧急照护或已经要求的报告。

Keep each original account and separate observations, reported information and unknown facts. Make a dated, traceable clarification using actual evidence. Do not delay urgent care or an already-required report to produce one agreed story.

CA-0006 · CORE-0006 · FAM-001 · home · DRAFT

门口交接 — 帮手职责未核实
Doorway handoff — Unverified helper

Jordan不在时，帮手主动要替他签收Leo。

A helper offers to sign Leo into Jordan's room although Jordan is absent.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？你可以考虑交出哪些工作，哪些责任必须由合格人员保留？

As the family child-care provider, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? Which tasks could you consider delegating, and which responsibilities must stay with eligible people?

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

只考虑该人实际职责允许的任务。不因对方愿意帮忙，就交出看护、算作合格人员或开放私人记录。安全照护责任必须明确。

Consider only tasks allowed for the person’s actual role. Do not transfer supervision, count the helper as qualified staff or disclose private records merely because help was offered. Keep the safe-care responsibility clearly assigned.

CA-0007 · CORE-0007 · FAM-001 · center · DRAFT

门口交接 — 向家庭说明
Doorway handoff — Family explanation

Leo家长询问门口交接由谁接手，也问到另一孩子细节。

Leo's parent asks who accepted care during a doorway exchange involving another child.

作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？现在向家庭说明什么，哪些要保密，哪些另行通知责任仍需处理？

As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? What would you tell the family now, what would remain private, and what separate notices might still be due?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

实务处理 / Practical approach

说明与该家庭孩子有关的已核实事实和实际行动，坦诚指出未知，限制无关隐私；另行处理适用的正式通知或报告。

Explain the verified facts relevant to that family’s child and what you actually did. State what remains unknown, restrict unrelated private details and handle any applicable official notice or report separately.

门口交接 — 防止再次发生
Doorway handoff — Preventing a repeat

门口反复吵闹，Mia总听不清Jordan是否接收Leo。

A loud doorway repeatedly prevents Mia from hearing Jordan's acceptance of Leo.

作为家庭托育负责人，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？你会作什么可衡量改变、由谁负责，又怎样检查是否有效？

Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。

Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.

孩子过生日后，未查转组条件就减少人员。

A birthday is used to reduce staffing before the permitted transition conditions are checked.

作为园长，改变年龄分类或减少人员前，你会先核实什么？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？

As director, what would you verify before changing this child's category or reducing staffing? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

不要只因儿童过生日就减少人员。先查适用的年龄定义和转组条件。

Do not reduce staff just because a birthday occurred. Check the age definition and any transition conditions in the applicable rule.

实务处理 / Practical approach

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Birthday transition”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A birthday does not by itself explain all staffing conditions. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证容量、年龄段、组别人数与计算规则。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

CA-0080 · CORE-0080 · FAM-008 · home · DRAFT

合并教室 — 说明处理经过
Room consolidation — Explaining the response

审阅人员询问合班后怎样覆盖换尿布需要。

A reviewer asks how a diapering need was covered after two groups merged.

作为家庭托育负责人，你会允许这样合班并让成人离开吗？必须先安排什么？你会提供什么真实时间线和证据，又会说明哪些不确定性？

As the family child-care provider, would you allow this combined group and departure, and what must be arranged first? What factual timeline and evidence would you provide, and what uncertainty would you disclose?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

关门前合班，也要检查合班后的年龄组合、组别人数、合格成人和房间许可。

Before joining groups, check the combined ages, qualified adults, group limit, and room approval. A quiet closing period still needs a valid plan.

实务处理 / Practical approach

按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。

Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“合并教室”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。合班改变的不只是房间里的人数。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Room consolidation”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Combining groups changes more than the number of children in a room. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证容量、年龄段、组别人数与计算规则。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify capacity, age bands, group size, and counting rules for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

实务处理 / Practical approach

按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

不要以为擦一下换尿布区域就能备餐。先核实允许用途和正确清洁处理步骤。

Do not turn a diapering area into a food surface just by wiping it. Check permitted uses and follow the correct treatment steps for that surface.

实务处理 / Practical approach

交代本事件、现有防护、必要的儿童个人说明和未决事项。请代班人员说出下一步并找到相关记录，再明确交接；实际岗位资格另行核实。

Brief the substitute on this event, the current safeguard, necessary child-specific instructions and any unresolved decision. Have them explain the next action and locate the relevant record before a clear handoff. Verify their actual role separately.

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Shared care surface”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Cleaning a surface does not automatically make every use permitted. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证手部卫生、换尿布、如厕与消毒规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

As the family child-care provider, how would you preserve each witness's account without delaying care or an already-required report? What factual timeline and evidence would you provide, and what uncertainty would you disclose?

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

分别保存每位目击者的事实陈述，注明未知情况，不等意见一致才提供照护或作已要求的报告。

Write each witness's own account separately and record what is unknown. Do not postpone needed care or a required report until everyone agrees.

实务处理 / Practical approach

按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。

Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“目击说法冲突”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。说法不同，不应成为改写事实或拖延照护的理由。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Conflicting witness accounts”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Different accounts do not justify rewriting history or delaying care. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

作为家庭托育负责人，你会怎样重写记录，说明事件、背景、成人回应和结果？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？

Write the observed event: “After a peer took the truck, Ava pushed a block toward that child.” Add the actual adult response and outcome. If either is unknown, record that uncertainty rather than invent a helpful response.

实务处理 / Practical approach

你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。

Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.

展开参考答案 / Reveal reference answer

必须事项（初稿） / Required actions (draft)

继续照看儿童，同时核实成人身份和当前接走授权；证件本身不能证明接走权限。

Keep the child supervised while checking the adult's identity and current pickup authorization. A driver's license identifies the adult but does not prove permission to collect this child.

实务处理 / Practical approach

先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“陌生接送人”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。知道成人是谁，不等于知道其有权接走这个儿童。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Unknown pickup adult”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Identity and permission to collect a particular child are separate checks. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

待确认事项 / Items to verify

按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证出勤、接走授权、监护信息与迟接规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

Find and verify attendance, release authorization, custody information, and late pickup for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. 实务处理 / Practical approach

按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。

Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.

记录与最佳实践 / Records and best practice

保留“可接触的危险物”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。不同危险物，需要不同安全收存方法。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Accessible restricted item”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Different hazards need different secure-storage methods. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

Find and verify household access, animals, weapons, approved areas, and household changes for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority.
